subject: SIG questionnaire — evidence timeline & delivery plan
messages:
From: Jill Kramer <jkramer@clearpath.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearpath.com, security@clearpath.com
Date: 2027-02-15T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + target timeline (Mar 10)

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement & security at ClearPath have a standard SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) they need completed before we can move to formal contracting. I attached the current XLSX with the sections we flagged as MUST-HAVE.

The team is targeting a Mar 10 SLA for final evidence (internal deadline). Would Redwood be able to:

- Return completed SIG answers (all tabs) by Mar 1 for initial review
- Deliver supporting evidence (SOC 2, SAML config, retention policy) by Mar 10

Items we specifically need evidence for: auth flows (SAML), SOC 2 attestation, data retention & deletion process, and any cross-region data flow diagrams. If any of these are going to be late, please flag now so procurement can burn down the timeline.

Attachments: ClearPath_SIG_Questions_v3.xlsx (questions + priority tags)

Best,
Jill Kramer
Director, Security & Compliance
ClearPath HealthTech

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Kramer <jkramer@clearpath.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-16T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + target timeline (Mar 10)

Hi Jill —

Appreciate the clear priorities and timeline. Quick plan from our side:

1) We will return completed SIG answers (marked where we need clarification) by EOD 2027-03-01.
2) Monica (security) will own the evidence bundle and deliver as many artifacts as possible by 2027-03-08, with final items (if any) by 2027-03-10.
3) If procurement requires any specific formatting for evidence (single archive, separate links, or signed cover letter), let us know now.

Blockers I see today: we need a final yes/no on whether you require redwood-managed customer logs (we can produce S3 access logs but need to ensure scope). Also, product needs to produce a data-flow diagram for cross-region replication — Monica, can you pull the current draft and indicate outstanding asks?

I will set up a 30-minute sync next week if that helps.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(sean_gallagher@redwood.ai)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Kramer <jkramer@clearpath.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-17T08:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + target timeline (Mar 10)

Hi Jill + team —

Thanks for the heads up, Sean — I can escalate the Mar 10 constraint on our side with Revenue Ops if we need deadline enforcement. A couple quick asks from procurement:

- If ClearPath requires a signed cover letter with the SOC2 summary, confirm and we will get that from Legal.
- Procurement prefers one consolidated evidence zip (with an index file) rather than multiple links. Is that acceptable?

If you confirm "single archive + index + optional cover letter", we will prioritize packaging the artifacts that way.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Kramer <jkramer@clearpath.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-23T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + target timeline (Mar 10)

Jill —

Status update from security/product:

- Completed: SOC2-TypeII-2026-summary.pdf (redacted summary) — attached.
- Completed: SAML configuration snippet and metadata (redwood_saml_config_snippet.txt) — attached.
- Draft: data_retention_policy_v2.pdf (final edits in progress; will be completed March 4).
- Outstanding: product needs to confirm cross-region replication diagram (I expect a 72-hour turnaround from product once I confirm the exact diagram scope).

We can produce a single archive with an index.csv and short cover note. If procurement still needs a signed legal attestation for the SOC, let us know and I'll loop Legal (that will add ~2 business days to delivery).

Attachments referenced: SOC2-TypeII-2026-summary.pdf, redwood_saml_config_snippet.txt

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Kramer <jkramer@clearpath.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpath.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + target timeline (Mar 10)

Thanks everyone for the update — the artifacts you listed should cover most of our asks. A couple notes from procurement/security: 

- Confirm we will receive a single ZIP archive (index + artifacts) by EOD 2027-03-05.
- If Legal attestation is required, procurement can accept a follow-up signed letter within 48 hours after the ZIP — please state if that is necessary.
- For the data-flow diagram, we only need an architecture diagram showing where PHI flows (redacted endpoints OK).

If you can confirm the March 5 delivery for the consolidated package, procurement will pause any further gating until they receive it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Jill Kramer
Director, Security & Compliance
ClearPath HealthTech
